__comment: skillforge factory dashboard — DEPLOY-ONLY dashboards-as-code (T-P4-03, docs/10 §'Example Grafana dashboard'). Sources: concept + first principles, zero third-party skills-factory files (clean-room). PromQL/LogQL expressions reference the public Claude Code metric/event names + the skillforge-namespaced signals the engine emits (skillforge.skill / skillforge.client resource attributes, skillforge.guardrail.status metric, skillforge.guardrail.result + skillforge.skill_result events, and the cache-hit fingerprint attributes). This file is the panel definition the operator-run stack draws; it is not exercised by CI.
title: skillforge — factory health

panels.title: Skill runs over time (by skill)
panels.description: claude_code.skill_activated grouped by the injected skillforge.skill attribute.

panels.title: Success rate (generation grain)
panels.description: skillforge.skill_result PASS ÷ total — the generation-grain success KPI (OBS-04), NOT proxied by api-error counts.

panels.title: Row 2 — Cost and volume (★ cache-hit + per-skill/per-client slicing)
Cost per skill / per client
panels.description: claude_code.cost.usage grouped by the injected skillforge.skill + skillforge.client resource attributes (OBS-01). Without the injection this would have no skill/client dimension to group by.

panels.title: ★ Cache-hit ratio (by client) + determinism owner
panels.description: cache-read ÷ (input + cache-creation + cache-read) from claude_code.token.usage, grouped by client. A DROP can come from EITHER prefix owner: tier 1 = CORE (skillforge.cache.tier1_prefix_hash), tier 2 = INPUT ADAPTER (skillforge.cache.tier2_content_hash). Read this panel alongside the two fingerprint tables below: whichever hash CHANGED names the owner at fault (OBS-02). If both held but the ratio dropped, the cause is downstream of the prefix.

panels.title: Cache fingerprint — tier 1 (CORE owner)
panels.description: The tier-1 prefix hash per run (skillforge.cache.tier1_prefix_hash). A change here when the cache-hit ratio drops attributes the break to the CORE's engine/skill text determinism.

panels.title: Cache fingerprint — tier 2 (INPUT ADAPTER owner)
panels.description: The tier-2 content hash per run (skillforge.cache.tier2_content_hash). A change here when the cache-hit ratio drops attributes the break to the INPUT ADAPTER's normalized-description determinism.

panels.title: Guardrail PASS/FAIL trend (E0–E10)
panels.description: skillforge.guardrail.status gauge per gate (1=PASS, 0=FAIL), fed by the CI guardrail bridge (tools/guardrail-bridge.js). The public gates appear as a verifiable subset; the local-only gates are bridged identically in private CI.

panels.title: Latest guardrail run
panels.description: skillforge.guardrail.result events — each gate, its PASS/FAIL, and the commit/PR/run it ran against. The clickable audit trail of WHY a gate failed.

panels.title: Recent permission denials
panels.description: claude_code.tool_decision (deny) — a spike can indicate a skill trying to step outside its sandbox.
